data.body:
[P2] Defer deadline retries until a fresh invocation

An `AiTimeoutError` occurs with about 10 seconds remaining, but these initial retry delays are shorter. If another parallel step remains `EXECUTING`, the checkpoint manager cannot suspend and can start the retry in the same invocation. `deadlineSignal()` then gives the request only 1 ms, consuming additional attempts without usable request time. Schedule deadline-triggered retries beyond the invocation reserve, and cover this with a runner-based test that keeps a sibling step active.
